headline: Champion Breweries and Bature Brewery Partner for Craft Beer Expansion
summary: Champion Breweries Plc partnered with Bature Brewery to brew and distribute craft beer nationwide, including an option to acquire three Bature brands.
why: Corporate partnerships and brand acquisitions in consumer goods enable regional expansion and product portfolio diversification.

impacts.name: Champion Breweries Plc
impacts.why: Distribution partnership and acquisition options expand product offerings.
